required_spaces.label: Kitchen (storkök or simple preparation)
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: Food preparation rooms must meet EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. II (design and layout permitting good hygiene, protection against contamination; facilities for cleaning/disinfecting tools; food-washing facilities where necessary) and ch. I (ventilation, drainage, lighting). Fire: storkök surfaces B-s1,d0 ceiling / C-s2,d0 wall (BFS 2024:7 5 kap. 17 §); storkök with particular fire risk = own fire cell unless an automatic extinguishing system limits the risk (5 kap. 26 §).

required_spaces.label: Kitchen exhaust duct (imkanal) and outlet
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: BFS 2024:7 4 kap. 23 §: imkanaler serving storkök at least EI 60 in byggnadsklass 1, EI 30 in byggnadsklass 2–3 (non-insulated parts allowed inside the served room with 0.10 m clearance, outdoors with 0.5 m); 24 §: storkök ducts with large combustible deposits need assured fire resistance inside the duct unless a deposit-limiting system is fitted; 5 kap. 20 §: imkanaler and hoods in storkök of non-combustible material; 4 kap. 22 §: household-type cooking (café) EI 15 or E 15. BFS 2024:8 9 kap. 1 §: exhaust outlets placed so pollutants/odours are not drawn back and no nuisance arises in the surroundings.

required_spaces.label: Dishwashing area
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. II p. 2: adequate facilities, where necessary, for cleaning, disinfecting and storage of working utensils and equipment, with hot and cold water. AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 7 § allmänna råd names dishwashers as equipment that may need a separate room.

required_spaces.label: Hand-wash basins
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. I p. 4 (adequate number, suitably located, hot and cold water, hygienic drying); kontrollwiki art. 1045 (separate from food-rinsing where necessary; must not be blocked by food/dishes).

required_spaces.label: Staff WC, changing room and shower
required_spaces.basis: EU 852/2004 Annex II ch. I p. 3 (lavatories not opening directly into food-handling rooms) and p. 9 (changing facilities where necessary); AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 46 § changing room when special work clothes are worn, 48 § normally separate for men/women if used simultaneously, 51 § shower normally if work is sweaty or dirty. Kontrollwiki art. 1045: food-law WC requirement concerns staff WCs; an antechamber may be needed if the WC is close to unprotected food.

required_spaces.label: Staff room (eating / pause / rest)
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 60–63 §§ (cross_cutting.json staff_eating_rest).

required_spaces.label: Waste room incl. food waste and used cooking oil
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design

GF.label: Shared building amenities (spaces serving several uses)

required_spaces.label: Shared entrance, lobby and reception
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: An accessible and easily perceived main entrance is required for every building that must be accessible (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 1 §). A reception in a publik lokal needs a hearing-aid sound transfer system (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §). A lobby that is also an escape route or access route is its own fire compartment (BFS 2024:7 5 kap. 25 § 1). A staffed reception is practice.

required_spaces.label: Bicycle parking / bicycle room
required_spaces.basis: BFS 2026:4 (in force 2026-07-01). New flerbostadshus: at least two bicycle parking spaces per bostadslägenhet, plus a reasonable number for larger cycles (2 kap. 2 §). New lokalbyggnad: spaces for at least 15 % of the average or 10 % of the total user capacity (2 kap. 4 §). On alteration the regulation applies only to an ombyggnad that involves the electrical infrastructure where the car parking is in the building, or one done together with changes to car parking on the plot (1 kap. 4 §); then the flerbostadshus count may be adapted if two per dwelling is not possible (3 kap. 1 §). From 2027-01-01 an EXISTING lokalbyggnad with more than 20 car parking spaces inside the building must also have the 15 % / 10 % bicycle spaces (4 kap. 3-4 §§). A building is a flerbostadshus if more than half its gross area is dwellings, otherwise a lokalbyggnad (1 kap. 7 §).

required_spaces.label: Accessible WC for visitors and the public
required_spaces.sized: 4.84 m² per_building
required_spaces.basis: If a publik lokal has toilets for the public, at least one must be accessible, with space to turn a wheelchair and transfer from both sides (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 §; cross_cutting access_public_premises_wc). Workplaces: at least one accessible WC per storey at new build or ombyggnad (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 4 § p. 6). Student housing using the 80 % accessibility exemption: at least one accessible WC for visitors in the building near the exempt dwellings (PBF 3 kap. 5 a § p. 3, see student_housing student_visitor_wc).

The general accessibility rules still apply. Control room and dressing rooms are practice.

required_spaces.basis: If a publik lokal has toilets for the public, at least one must be accessible, with space to turn a wheelchair and transfer from both sides (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 7 §; cross_cutting access_public_premises_wc). Workplaces: at least one accessible WC per storey at new build or ombyggnad (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 4 § p. 6). Student housing using the 80 % accessibility exemption: at least one accessible WC for visitors in the building near the exempt dwellings (PBF 3 kap. 5 a § p. 3, see student_housing student_visitor_wc).

F1.label: Office
F1.travel_how: from the far corner to a stair in the core

required_spaces.label: Workplaces (desks, open-plan or cellular)
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 5 § — workplaces shall have sufficient area and free height for the activity; 3 kap. 6 § sufficient freedom of movement.

required_spaces.label: Ventilation capacity (outdoor air supply)
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 4 § — indoor workplaces shall normally be supplied with at least 7 l/s outdoor air per person plus at least 0.35 l/s per m2 floor area during working hours; allmänna råd: 7 l/s applies to sedentary work, higher activity may need more. 5 kap. 3 § allmänna råd: air-change effectiveness should be at least 40 %.

required_spaces.label: Quiet / focus rooms
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 2 § — workplaces shall have the rooms needed for the activity; allmänna råd names 'tysta rum' as an example.

required_spaces.label: Eating room / staff kitchen
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 60 § — employees shall be able to eat in suitable rooms with tables and chairs with backrests (also those eating brought food); 61 § — near the place where brought food is eaten there shall be a refrigerator, means to heat food and to wash dishes. 36 § — drinking water near workplaces and eating areas.

required_spaces.label: Pause / break area
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 62 § — place for pauses with possibility for short recovery and enough seats with backrests.

required_spaces.label: Rest space / rest room
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 63 § — there shall be, or be quickly arrangeable, a suitable rest space for temporary, undisturbed, lying rest. Allmänna råd: a separate vilrum may be needed when more than 50 persons are employed simultaneously in the same area; a WC should be nearby.

required_spaces.label: WCs incl. accessible WC
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 56 § sufficient WCs and washbasins near workplaces/pause rooms; 57 § sufficiently large, separate, lockable, washbasin, no direct connection to eating room; 58 § accessible WCs at existing workplaces for those who need them; 3 kap. 4 § p. 6 — when designing new build/ombyggnad at least one accessible WC per storey.

required_spaces.label: Clothes and valuables storage
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 40 § storage for private clothes for all who need it at the same time; 41 § lockable storage for personal valuables.

required_spaces.label: Cleaning and building-service room
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 2 § allmänna råd names spaces for property maintenance and service as examples of rooms that may be needed.

required_spaces.label: Print / copy room
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 7 § — processes with particular risk normally in separate room; allmänna råd names copying machines (and fans, charging batteries, dishwashers) as examples that may need a separate room.

required_spaces.label: Waste room
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: BFS 2024:8 11 kap. 1–3 §§ — waste shall be manageable in or next to the building; waste devices or waste rooms located, designed and dimensioned for hygiene and collection.

F1.label: Gym / fitness centre
F1.travel_how: from the far corner to a stair in the core

required_spaces.label: Ventilation capacity for high activity
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: BFS 2024:8 3 kap. 4 § (functional: continuous air change, removal of pollutants from the intended use). AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 4 §: at least 7 l/s per person plus 0.35 l/s per m2 for workplaces; allmänna råd: 7 l/s is for sedentary work and higher activity may need more.

required_spaces.label: Reception / access control
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: If staffed, a reception in a publik lokal needs a hearing-aid sound transfer system (BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 §). Accessible main entrance (2 kap. 1 §).

required_spaces.label: Staff facilities
required_spaces.sized: required — no size in any source; size by design
required_spaces.basis: AFS 2023:12. Instructors do sweaty work, so changing rooms and showers apply (3 kap. 46, 52 §§). See cross_cutting.json staff_changing_showers_storage.
